improvements.title: Session directory naming could be more discoverable
improvements.description: Session storage uses ~/.pi/agent/sessions/ with project paths encoded as directory names (e.g., --Users-ricardo-Workshop-GitHub-agent-pi--). Consider documenting the directory structure in --help examples or a session guide.

improvements.title: --export example shows relative paths; consider absolute path guidance
improvements.description: Help text shows 'pi --export session.jsonl output.html' but --export appears to validate that the input file exists. Docs could clarify that source must be an existing session file path.
